mainEntity.name: How much does a Range Rover Evoque P300e engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full rebuilt Range Rover Evoque P300e engine typically costs between £2,500 and £5,500 for supply only. Reconditioned units start around £2,500, while used engines can be found from £2,000. Prices vary based on whether you choose supply-only or a full supply and fit service.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of hybrid system failure in a Range Rover Evoque P300e?

acceptedAnswer.text: Early warning signs include a significant reduction in electric-only range, hybrid fault lights on the dashboard, or inverter overheating warnings. You might also experience software fault codes (P0A0A, U0422) requiring module resets.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a Range Rover Evoque P300e?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, given the current premium vehicle market. A well-maintained Range Rover Evoque P300e holds a value of £20,000 to £42,000+. Investing £2,500-£5,500 in a rebuilt engine with a 12-month warranty is financially viable and protects the appreciating asset value of this premium hybrid SUV.

mainEntity.name: What is the AJ20P4H engine code in the Range Rover Evoque P300e?

acceptedAnswer.text: The AJ20P4H is the specific 1.5-litre three-cylinder Ingenium petrol engine code fitted to the Range Rover Evoque P300e, paired with an 80kW electric motor. It produces a combined 305hp and features advanced direct injection and a sophisticated thermal management system.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Range Rover Evoque P300e engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A professional supply and fit service for a Range Rover Evoque P300e typically takes 5 to 10 working days. This includes the removal of the old unit, high-voltage system isolation, installation of the replacement engine, and comprehensive software calibration.
